name: researched-prices
title: VPS and proxy list prices by country, 2026-10 snapshot
description: Public list prices of VPS/VDS hosting (603 offers, 25 providers, 32 countries) and paid proxies (455 rows, 31 brands), taken from providers' own pricing pages between 2026-08-30 and 2026-09-24. RUB and EUR converted to USD at a fixed Bank of Russia snapshot dated 2026-09-24. Curated list, mostly providers relevant to Russian-speaking buyers.

sources.title: Providers' public pricing pages (one URL per row in Pricing page)
Bank of Russia daily exchange rates, 2026-09-24

resources.name: vps-plans
resources.title: VPS plans by country
resources.description: One row per VPS plan and country. 1,686 rows from 603 offers; the file has no offer id, so rows are not offers.

fields.name: Provider
fields.description: Provider name.

fields.name: Plan
fields.description: Plan name as published. When identical plans were merged in one country, the first name is shown. Selectel plans named "Shared ... (10% vCPU)" guarantee 10% of a core.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Hosting country (English name).

fields.name: City
fields.description: Hosting city in English; several cities are joined by "; ". Empty when the provider names only a country, a country code or a datacenter without a city.

fields.name: vCPU
fields.description: Number of vCPU as published.

fields.name: RAM (GB)
fields.description: RAM in GB.

fields.name: Disk (GB)
fields.description: Disk size in GB.

fields.name: Disk type
fields.description: Disk type. Empty when not stated.

fields.name: Traffic (TB/month)
fields.description: TB per month as a number, "Unlimited", or empty when not stated. Text type because of "Unlimited".

fields.name: Port (Mbps)
fields.description: Port speed in Mbit/s. Empty when not published.

fields.name: Price (USD/month)
fields.description: Monthly price in USD, 2 decimals. RUB and EUR converted at the fixed 2026-09-24 snapshot, USD as published, Beget's daily price multiplied by 30.

fields.name: Price (original)
fields.description: Monthly price in the provider's currency, as published. Beget publishes a daily price; its 11 rows show 30 times that price.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: Currency of Price (original).

fields.name: Crypto payment
fields.description: Provider lists a cryptocurrency. Empty = payment methods unknown (WAICORE, 1cent.host), not "No".

fields.name: Russian cards (Mir/SBP)
fields.description: Provider lists Mir, SBP or SberPay (a generic "Bank card" is not counted). Empty = unknown.

fields.name: Pricing page
fields.description: Official page recorded as the source of the price, no referral parameters. May be a provider or product-family page.

fields.name: Checked on
fields.description: Date the price was observed (YYYY-MM-DD). Earliest date if merged plans differ.

resources.name: proxy-prices
resources.title: Proxy entry prices by country
resources.description: One row per proxy product line and country where the provider publishes per-country prices, otherwise one row for all countries. Unit is per IP, per port or per GB.

fields.name: Provider
fields.description: Brand name; the product variant is in brackets, e.g. "IPRoyal (ISP)", "Proxywing (DC)". For Shared proxies the bracket is the kind of proxy: static, mobile or residential.

fields.name: Proxy type
fields.description: Static, Residential, Mobile or Shared.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: English country name, or "All countries" when the provider has one price for every location. When the provider gives a single price tied to one country, that country is shown.

fields.name: Price from
fields.description: Entry price in the provider's currency, as published.

fields.name: Unit
fields.description: What the price buys. Do not compare across units.

fields.name: Period (days)
fields.description: Billing period: 30 for per-IP and per-port prices; mostly empty for per-GB prices.

fields.name: Min. quantity
fields.description: Minimum quantity for this per-piece price (1 = none), e.g. 100 IPs.

fields.name: Price (USD)
fields.description: Price from in USD, 2 decimals (RUB at the fixed 2026-09-24 snapshot).

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: Currency of Price from.

fields.name: Free trial
fields.description: "No"; "Yes (...)" free trial with its size; "On request (...)" free trial on request; "Paid test (...)" paid trial with its price; "Free proxy list only" = the provider publishes a free proxy list, not a trial of the paid product.

fields.name: Crypto payment
fields.description: A cryptocurrency or crypto processor is listed.

fields.name: Russian cards (Mir/SBP)
fields.description: Mir, SBP or SberPay is listed.

fields.name: Pricing page
fields.description: Official provider page the price was taken from, no referral parameters.

fields.name: Checked on
fields.description: Date the price was observed (YYYY-MM-DD).
